# proxmox_node_ceph_pools (Data Source)

Lists Ceph pools from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/pool`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_pools" "p" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `pools` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))

<a id="nestedatt--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Read-Only:

- `bytes_used` (Number)
- `crush_rule_name` (String)
- `min_size` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `percent_used` (Number)
- `pg_autoscale_mode` (String)
- `pg_num` (Number)
- `pg_num_min` (Number)
- `pool_id` (Number)
- `size` (Number)
- `type` (String)
